exchange.speaker: RDO
exchange.text: <callsign>, Goliad RDO, roger departing, have a safe flight.

cards.title: Depart the Goliad pattern
instructions: Once number one upwind, climb to 800' MSL · 240 KIAS
Turn 45° away from the RWY {from.runway} heading, opposite the pattern ({from.runway.patternSide} side is the pattern)
At or below pattern altitude until clear of the pattern

cards.title: Climb toward KINGS 4
instructions: Climb to no higher than 4,500' MSL until cleared into the MOA

cards.title: Request KINGS 4 clearance
cards.leadIn: Contact Houston Center for clearance into the MOA:
instructions: Check with an instructor for the exact wording from Goliad
cards.source: 3710.14, para 2.j(2) and (3); phraseology from the binder, p. 10.

cards.title: Switch to KINGS 4 Common
instructions: Switch to KINGS 4 Common (UHF CH 20) no later than 8,000' MSL
Switch to Houston Center · VHF CH 22 or VHF CH 23 when directed by Center

cards.title: Enter KINGS 4
instructions: Enter using a low block, the lower transition layer, or both, as applicable
Do not penetrate the lateral boundary until established at the transition altitude and cleared by Houston Center
If weather precludes the transition layer, coordinate with ATC
